KITTY / PROMETHEUS · V7
SERVICE REVISION · FIT PENDING

KITTY V7. Team PROMETHEUS.

Raised PROMETHEUS lettering sits above the front collar; KITTY sits below the rear tail mount so the name stays visible. The folded collar, faceted neck cuff, clipped phone bezel and detachable tail complete the V7 body. This service revision adds replaceable, slotted motor cradles and four first-print fit samples. The separate body set retains 13 parts, with the internal AA tray optional; use purchased wheels, motors and phone.

Review the shape

PROMETHEUS and KITTY are raised CAD geometry fused into their covers. They print in the shell material and can be painted after printing. The chest fold, neck cuff and ear facets share the same angular detail. Motor cradles reserve the user’s estimated 65 × 24 × 20 mm upper envelope and offer proposed ±2 mm fore/aft adjustment. The optional internal tray uses straps, with its side ears removed for clearance. Aqua eyes are display placeholders.

The tail uses a keyed socket and proposed M3 cross screw, above the service openings. Remove the screw, then follow the small arrow on the screw-entry side and pull rearward. The arrow shows direction only. Tail joint shows a 35 mm exploded gap; the screw is omitted. The proposed 0.4 mm fit clearance still needs a sample.

Before printing the separate parts

The user clarified a 62.5 mm outside wheel diameter and estimated motor ranges of 61–65 × 22–24 × 18–20 mm. Shaft position, tyre axial width/hub, caster, outside AA-holder restraint, phone case/camera access and printer settings remain unverified. Print and try the four fit samples and one real motor cradle before commissioning the large covers.

Each part needs fit and slicer/support review. Start with FIT_TEST_FIRST/ and the service brief; STL_PARTS/ contains the body pieces. Wheels, motors, phone and electronics in this viewer are references; their meshes are excluded from that folder. The V7 design export is not a physically fit-verified release.
